name: dogfood-search-faceted-geo-app
description: Dogfood app v1.36-3 — an Algolia-anchored faceted-advanced + geo search harness driven behind a provider-neutral 15-op contract backed by @kiwa/search v0.3 semantics (faceted-advanced + geo axes) + real-driver env-gate against Algolia sandbox. Two adapter implementations satisfy the same contract: makeMockAdapter walks the search v0.3 faceted-advanced + geo state machines deterministically without any backend; makeRealAdapter models the wire surface for the Algolia HTTP API behind the KIWA_MODE=real env-gate (KIWA_ALGOLIA_URL + ALGOLIA_KEY) and otherwise reports KIWA_SEARCH_ENV_MISSING so callers can budget the fallback. The fidelity harness diffs both traces side-by-side across 3 fixture sets (categories / restaurants / events) x 4 facet queries x 3 geo queries so behavioural drift between mock semantics and the real Algolia wire surface stays observable and feeds the @kiwa/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/search -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
